import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
xl = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)
print("Sheets:", xl.sheet_names)

# Load Transactions
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Transactions')
print(df.head())
print(df.columns.tolist())
# Check unique months
print(df['Month'].unique()[:20])
# Filter for Jul 2025
jul = df[df['Month'] == 'Jul 2025']
print("Jul rows count:", len(jul))
total_jul = jul['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print("Total Jul spend:", total_jul)
